methods.label: Choose the make-ten split
methods.explanation: Adding 1 to 9 makes 10, so split 3 into 1 and 2: \(9+1=10\), \(10+2=12\).
methods.levelReason: Splitting 3, completing 10, and forming 12 are all within Grade 1 scope.
